name: bramble-charming

purpose.why: Rebuilt on Evan's request (2026-10-22) to replace the Ranch tile's original model with a crafted one, keeping its game role.
purpose.audience: children building and playing in a miniature ranch

brief.prompt: a whimsical storybook version of a low sprawling blackberry bramble with arching canes, leaves and dark berries, oversized plump petals and leaves, bouncy rounded toy-like shapes

concept.tool: Midjourney web app (midjourney.com/imagine), driven in Evan's signed-in Chrome by Claude through the Claude in Chrome extension, one job at a time, text prompts only (no image reference)

hero.prompt: a whimsical storybook version of a low sprawling blackberry bramble with arching canes, leaves and dark berries, oversized plump petals and leaves, bouncy rounded toy-like shapes, stylized 3D game asset, low-poly diorama style, flat painted colors, soft studio lighting, plain warm cream background, centered, full object visible, no text --ar 1:1
hero.pick_reason: low sprawl with a clear arching cane, plump leaves and many dark berries, whole bramble in frame

construction.by: modeler agent, directed by the art director (Claude)

rounds.change: Charming rebuild from the normal build.py: mound right of centre, fat cane curling left, ground runner, plump 8-tri leaves, 7-drupelet berries, lilac buds. 1,874 tris.
Bigger berries and buds, darker leaf greens, fewer light leaves, a leafy crown round the right sprig.
Berries as lumpy faceted 36-tri balls (round toy berries instead of spiky diamonds); leaf pair above the arch moved left and enlarged.
Buds rounded into two-ring bulbs (20 tris). Tested box heights 1.20 (0.571) and 1.42 (0.619); kept 1.30.
Higher right flank of the mound; tried moving the crown right/lower (0.595, reverted).
Tried a taller arch (0.600, reverted). Final 768 px / 48 samples; to_game.py bramble-charming.

what_was_done: Copied build.py, make_views.py, hero_check.py and run.sh from models/bramble and kept their structure: same material names and roles (Leaf_Bramble, Leaf_BrambleLight, Leaf_BrambleShade, Stem_Cane, Berry_Black) plus one new Flower_Lilac for the new buds, same mesh names, same origin (footprint centre on the ground), front -Y, Z up, no animation, same 2.12 x 1.06 m footprint (2:1 width to depth).

Hero only (no turnaround for this plant). make_views.py, unchanged except for the path, keys the cream backdrop per row and drops the olive-grey cast shadow below row 1380 by hue; the mask keeps the berries and runner on the ground. Keyed hero aspect 0.657.
hero_check.py unchanged: front-on (yaw 0), 10 deg up, harness lens, same as the normal bramble, so the two scores compare.

Follows the charming hero, which is mirrored from the normal one: a chubby leafy mound sits right of centre, one fat cane rises out of it and curls over to the left where it droops a berry and a lilac bud, an upright sprig and a leafy crown stand on the right, and a ground runner trails berries off to the left.

Leaves are plump rounded cards (8 tris) with cupped edges and a puffed centre, 1.5-2x the normal leaf size and smooth-shaded; the main cane is a fat 6-sided tube (radius 3.4 cm) ending in a rounded bead, carrying leaves on little stalks; berries are toy-big lumpy faceted balls (about 0.2 m across, 36 tris) instead of drupelet clusters; 14 lilac flower buds in green cups add the hero's colour; the shade core is a fatter dome so the mound reads chubby; big skirt leaves spill onto the ground at the front and the right end.

Box 2.12 x 1.06 x 1.30 m (normal: 2.12 x 1.06 x 1.06). 1.30 tall matches the charming hero (1.20 scored 0.571, 1.42 scored 0.619). The regional loader scales to spec height, so in game this bramble is about 82 % of the normal one's width; set P['fit'][2] to 1.06 if the two must match exactly.

1,952 triangles (normal 1,976; budget 2k) in 6 meshes, one flat material each. Leaf/Stem/Flower names keep the foliage shading and seasonal recolour. to_game.py bramble-charming installed simulations/regional-assets-charming/WW-273.glb (byte-identical to bramble-charming.glb) and updated the charming manifest.
construction.creative_additions: Lilac flower buds in green cups (from the hero), a rounded bead at the cane tips, leaves on little stalks along the arch, and toy-big faceted berries rolled out on the ground.

geometry.up: Z (Blender source); Y in GLB and game
geometry.origin: centre of the footprint, on the ground

good: Reads as the same bramble in storybook-toy form: a chubby leaf mound, one fat green cane arching over with big berries hanging, lilac buds dotted through, and berries rolled out on the ground.
Same footprint ratio, origin, material roles and triangle budget as the normal model, so it drops into the same slot.
Hero IoU 0.611 against the normal model's 0.619 on its own hero.
off: The hero's leaf mass right of the arch root (between the arch and the mound) and the top of its wide right flank are fuller than 2k triangles allow; the IoU moves about +-0.01 with the leaf random seed.
The front ground leaves and berries project a little below the hero's flat bottom edge because the model keeps the normal's 1.06 m depth and the hero looks shallower.
The hero's half-open rose-like blossoms are simplified to closed rounded buds, and its many small drupelets to faceted lumps; at the tile's size they read as buds and berries.
In-game width is about 82 % of the normal bramble's (taller box, see Size).

rights: Original work for Abbie's World. Concept art generated on Evan's Midjourney account; geometry generated procedurally, no third-party meshes or textures.
